sections.title: State Overview
paragraphs:
Amapá is located in the North region of Brazil with its capital in Macapá.
With a population of 877,000, Amapá offers a unique blend of
opportunities and lifestyle experiences. The state is characterized by its Mining, Energy Generation, Tourism, Forestry
and is known for being Adventure-seekers and pioneers welcome.

Climate:
Tropical - Hot and humid with distinct rainy season
Temperature Range:
23-31°C year-round
Average Monthly Salary:
R$ 2,600-5,200 average monthly salary

sections.title: Economy & Employment
paragraphs:
Amapá's economy is built on Mining, Energy Generation, Tourism, Forestry. The state offers significant opportunities
for both local and international professionals seeking employment and business ventures.

Employment Outlook:
Amapá presents strong opportunities across multiple sectors,
with salaries ranging from R$ 2,600-5,200 average monthly salary for average positions.

sections.title: Education & Universities
paragraphs:
Amapá boasts several excellent universities and educational institutions, making it ideal for
students and families seeking quality education.

Education Options:
From public universities to private institutions, Amapá offers
diverse educational opportunities. Many universities offer programs in English for international students.
